item.title: Summary of the II Free Culture Days 2023
item.description: Here we celebrated the II Free Culture Days: on March 29 and 30, 2023, at the URJC Management Building, a very special event for our OfiLibre, where professionals, students, and researchers came together to promote Free Culture.
